data.long_meaning: In Greek, Telesphore means 'bringing completeness' or 'bringing to perfection'. In Christian tradition, it is the name of several early Christian martyrs and saints. The name Telesphore carries the meaning “Bringing completeness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Telesphore usually hope their child will grow to embody bringing completeness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: טלספורי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: טלספורי הוא שם שפירושו 'מושיע', 'מושיע מרחקים', או 'הושיע'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'Τήλεσφορος' (Tēlesphoros), שפירושו 'נושא הסוף' או 'מושיע'. השם קשור למושג ההצלה והישועה, ומשמש לעיתים קרובות בהקשר של ישועת הנפש.

in_greek.name: Τήλεσφορος
in_greek.long_meaning: Τήλεσφορος (Tēlesphoros) σημαίνει 'ο φέρων τέλος' (המוביל את הסוף) או 'ο σώζων' (המושיע). Το όνομα αυτό έχει συνδεθεί με την έννοια της σωτηρίας και της θεραπείας. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Τήλεσφορος συνδέεται με την αποστολή του Χριστού να σώσει την ανθρωπότητα.

in_latin.name: Telesphorus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Telesphorus significat 'finem ferens' vel 'salvator'. Etymologia nominis haud clara est, sed cum notione salvationis et curationis coniungitur. In traditione christiana, Telesphorus fuit etiam nomen unius e sanctis martyrum.

in_english.name: Telesphore
in_english.meaning: Bringer of completion, finisher, or savior
in_english.long_meaning: The name Telesphore originates from the Greek 'Τήλεσφορος' (Tēlesphoros), meaning 'bringer of completion' or 'finisher'. It is associated with the concept of salvation and healing. Historically, Telesphore has been used in Christian tradition, symbolizing the completion of faith or the journey to spiritual salvation. The name is linked to early Christian martyrs and saints.

This ancient Greek name has been passed down through generations, and its cultural impact can be seen in the multitude of churches, monasteries, and other religious institutions that bear the name of Saint Telesphore. Additionally, there are several locations named after the saint in various parts of the world, including cities, towns, and parishes. The name Telesphore has also been adopted by various Christian communities, including the Greek and Roman Catholic Churches, and is used as a given name for boys.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Telesphore holds deep spiritual significance for Christians. The Greek root of the name, 'tele,' means 'completeness' or 'perfection,' implying a sense of wholeness and completeness in the Christian faith. In the context of the Christian tradition, Telesphore is often interpreted as a name that represents the ultimate goal of the faithful: to bring one's life to completion and perfection in union with God. The name also serves as a reminder of the importance of striving for spiritual growth and perfection, both in one's individual relationship with God and in the broader Christian community. Ultimately, the name Telesphore can be seen as a symbol of the ultimate fulfillment of the Christian life - a life of love, faith, and devotion to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Telesphore, meaning "carrying forth" or "bringing to completion," symbolizes the unwavering commitment to bring God's grace and love to fulfillment in one's life and in the world. It is a reminder to continue striving towards spiritual growth and service to others, even in the face of adversity.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
